Remark
[injectivity radius gives local volume and precompactness]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ prop:pet-ch11-gromov-precompactness-criterion 1. ch11:11.6.3Croke's estimate gives a universal $c(n)$ for which every $n$-manifold with $\inj \ge R$ satisfies $\vol B(p,r)\ge c(n)r^n$ for $r\le R/e$; use this to show the class of $n$-manifolds with $\inj \ge R$, $\vol \le V$ is precompact in the Gromov--Hausdorff topology.
